name: aether
description: Aether mode for Claude Code, built for RADAR: rapid, autonomous, delegating, affordable and robust. The Lead on Sonnet is the owner's right hand: it understands the intent, writes the spec, and orchestrates. A Writer on Sonnet writes plans and tasks in Spec Kit's layout, and a Judge on Opus reviews them. A parallel swarm of Haiku, Sonnet and Opus implementers builds them, each attempt supervised and every merge made one at a time. Lanes run its calls on other coding plans, such as agy, while their quota lasts. With the owner's permission, the Lead works for hours and ends with a brief.

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Run Aether's calls on agy while its quota lasts. Off by default: agy runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions and spends another plan's quota. Linux only.

harnesses.title: Lane harnesses
harnesses.description: The external harnesses lanes may use, comma-separated, in order of preference: agy, codex, grok, cursor. Default: agy. Each one runs its CLI without permission prompts in Aether's transactional worktree, with your git, GitHub, package-registry and cloud credentials kept out of its environment. Turn one on only once you accept that risk.
